verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas is fundamentally a lightweight, browser-first WebGL engine (npm-published, MIT) with explicit WebGPU support and automatic fallback to WebGL2 when WebGPU isn't available, giving a credible dual-API story. Community evidence corroborates it as a strong web-focused engine with impressive live examples (Venge.io) and lightweight design relative to heavier engines. Missing for 10: independent payload-size benchmarks, and more detail on WebGPU feature parity/performance vs WebGL in production.
